prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":1,"r":1},"outputs":{"q":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"Q","meaning":"Stored flip-flop value, driven to q","update_time":"posedge clk","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R1_sync_reset","outputs":["q"],"condition":"r == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"r":1},{"d":0,"r":1},{"d":1,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":0},{"q":1}]}},{"id":"R2_capture_d","outputs":["q"],"condition":"r == 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"Implement a simple D flip flop","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":0,"r":0},{"d":1,"r":0},{"d":0,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":1},{"q":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"r","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"first posedge clk with r == 0"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
